name: synthetic-submit-rejected
description: SYNTHETIC: DashScope rejects the call with HTTP 400 and its error envelope ({code, message, request_id} — the shape the reference pages document). No task is created and no image is generated, so nothing will ever be billed; the run settles as zero-billed data with the vendor's status. Serves the video submit and the blocking image call alike (same envelope on both paths).
